subject: Connector subscriber provisioning and billing edge-case review
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@nebula-sys.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: cynthia.lawson@cloudbroker.io
Date: Thu, 19 Dec 2029 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Connector provisioning + billing edge cases for Nebula integration

Hi Markus / Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We spun up a small pilot (Nebula Systems) that will provision subscribers to Redwood via the CloudBroker connector. During integration we hit two billing edge-cases that I want to flag before we go live:

- trial-to-paid transitions where the customer converts mid-hour (metering window alignment)
- reseller pass-through where CloudBroker credits get applied before marketplace settlement

I've attached a short sheet with sample invoices and a diagram of our current provisioning flow (connector-provisioning-sheet.xlsx, billing-edgecase-diagram.png).

Can we do a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on: entitlement mapping, which SKU we should expose on AWS/GCP, and whether Redwood needs to emit a separate metering event for reseller credits?

Appreciate it —
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Integrations, Nebula Systems

Karthik / Olga — forwarding Nebula's note. Short summary and asks:

Summary: Nebula's CloudBroker connector provisions subscribers that then consume hosted Redwood models. They hit two edge cases: trial->paid mid-meter-window, and reseller credits that must be applied pre-settlement.

Asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm whether our meter windows (1m/5m depending on SKU) can support a mid-window state change and what the external event must look like? If we can't emit a split-charge, what's the recommendation for downstream accounting?
- Olga: who owns the entitlement tag that indicates "reseller_credit_applied=true"? Do we need a new metadata field in the entitlement/provisioning API?

I proposed 11:00 PST sync with Sanjay and asked for a sample payload. Please review the attached XLS (connector-provisioning-sheet.xlsx) before the call. I'll take notes and file an INFR ticket if we need a runtime change.

Thanks — Mark

(attachment: connector-provisioning-sheet.xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Dec 2029 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Connector provisioning + billing edge cases for Nebula integration

Markus — quick notes before the sync:

- Meter windows: our default aggregator uses a 1-minute soft window and a 5-minute committed window for host-sku tokens. We cannot split a single committed window into two separate invoice lines today.
- Recommendation: emit a conversion-event with timestamp; we'll attribute usage to the window containing the event timestamp and attach a conversion flag. For customers that need per-minute proration, we can offer a post-process adjustment (billing-side) but not inline split-charge.
- Reseller credits: we already have an entitlement metadata slot (metadata.tags) but we don't propagate credit information into marketplace settlement records. Olga, if we add a "reseller_credit_reference" field to entitlement, marketplace ops can ingest it for reporting.

I'll bring a brief runbook to the call (link below) and be ready to propose a small API tweak if needed.

Karthik
Lead, Billing & Pricing

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-2432

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@nebula-sys.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Cynthia Lawson <cynthia.lawson@cloudbroker.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Dec 2029 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Connector provisioning + billing edge cases for Nebula integration

Thanks everyone for the call — good alignment. Meeting notes (brief):

- Nebula will emit a "conversion_event" with ISO timestamp and trial_id in the metering payload.
- Redwood will record conversion_event and tag the usage row with conversion=true; attribution will follow the event timestamp's window.
- For customers that require invoice-level split we will support an out-of-band billing adjustment via CloudBroker (post-settlement).
- Reseller credits: Nebula will include reseller_reference in their provisioning payload; Redwood will add reseller_credit_reference to entitlement metadata (prototype patch to be submitted by Karthik).

Attachments: updated connector-provisioning-sheet.xlsx (v2) — includes sample JSON payload and proposed entitlement field.

Next steps / owners:
- Nebula: deliver final sample payload + sign updated SOW (Sanjay) — ETA 2029-12-23
- Karthik: open INFR ticket for entitlement field + small acceptance tests — ETA 2029-12-27
- Olga: confirm marketplace reporting needs and whether we need to propagate credit metadata into settlement export (loop in AWS ops as needed) — ETA 2029-12-27
- Markus / Ben: coordinate with CS to schedule a dry-run once SOW signed — ETA 2029-12-30

(attachment: connector-provisioning-sheet-v2.xlsx)

Sanjay
